newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev consolidates at 1,495-1,500 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev consolidates at 1,495-1,500 to dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev consolidated at 1,495-1,500 per dollar in light interbank volume around 1100 local time (0800 GMT) from opening between 1,485-1,505, dealers said.
"Trade has been sluggish this morning so far. Thin dollar volumes are changing hands around 1,495-1,500 levs," a bank dealer said.
Dealers expected trade to remain calm and in a narrow spread by the end of the day as no major end clients were seen coming to market bidding for dollars. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
